description: Build a physical product or service using startup design principles, product-building practice, first-customer acquisition ideas, and iterative relaunch after customer approach attempts.
Map out a customer acquisition plan using launch planning, first-customer acquisition, user growth, market research, MVP timing, fundraising context, and iterative relaunch strategies.
Launch a product through different channels using user growth, selling, KPI setting, startup growth, and relaunch strategies.
Analyze feedback from launch channels using selling evidence, KPI and goal setting, market research, MVP timing, growth analysis, and relaunch feedback.
